resolution.note: parallel lanes rule shipped; second executor and measurement in t-vgd1bp3

title: Run two independent lead slices in parallel
body:
Outcome: two lead sessions run independent slices in parallel within the host cap of 2 deliveries, under the "Parallel lanes" rule in docs/program/lead-rules.md.
Scope narrowed 2026-11-02 by the lead under the blanket grant: the second Jenkins executor and the before/after throughput measurement moved to t-vgd1bp3, because measured queue wait is about 3 min per PR against a 49 min median open-to-merge (n=40) and a second runner needs a VM pool on a PVE host this lead cannot reach.
Evidence (2026-11-02): krn/gate takes 7-8 min per run; #166 waited about 8 min behind #165 on the single slot; open-to-merge typically 30-114 min, outliers #162 541 min, #150 796 min from review rounds; host 16 cores, about 11 GB free RAM, load about 3-9.
